stem.text: A snooker ball has a mass of $200\,\text{g}$. It hits the cushion of a snooker table and rebounds along its original path.

The ball arrives at the cushion with a speed of $14.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and then leaves it with a speed of $7.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The ball and the cushion are in contact for a time of $0.60\,\text{s}$.
What is the average force exerted on the ball by the cushion?
